items.title: How ‘Cash Returns’ Are Replacing AI Momentum
items.summary: “Over the last two months investors have shifted to paying up for certainty of cash returns while paring back their willingness to pay for future expected cash returns related to AI investments,” he wrote.  Among 16 different stock factors 22V tracks, cash return, defined as dividends and buybacks as a share of net income, has performed the best this year, gaining 14.2% year to date.  In addition to worries about profit growth, investors appear to be focused on rising bond yields.

items.title: Want Double-Digit Gains From Insurance Stocks? Morgan Stanley Suggests 2 Names to Consider
items.summary: Insurance has spent the past 20 years doing many of the things investors usually appreciate, without getting much credit for them. What it has not done particularly well is turn steady business growth into equally strong profit growth. items.title: Morgan Stanley’s Khanduja Scales Back US Curve Bets on Bessent Plan

items.title: Dynatrace upgraded by Morgan Stanley as observability demand boosts growth
items.summary: Investing.com -- Morgan Stanley upgraded Dynatrace Inc to Overweight from Equal-weight on Tuesday, saying improving demand for observability software, a large customer renewal cycle and stronger artificial intelligence capabilities could drive a sustained acceleration in growth.
